text:
maria: kicking off Ceres LoRA merge into pegasus-2x on my dev box. goal: tiny smokepack (int8 + int4) focused on tokenizer remap and stop-token/truncation behavior before CS handoff.

sam: copy. reminder: Ceres adds 4 custom tokens. are we remapping to host ids or assigning high-id range?

maria: adapter metadata remaps to high-id range (customers/ceres/token_map.json). noticed one long-form prompt truncates earlier than expected after merge, likely tokenizer->KV ordering mismatch.

eli: can you paste the quick local results?

maria: quick local smoke (no KV cache):
```
run_id: ceres-local-2026-03-21
model: pegasus-2x + ceres-lora
quant: int8
seq_len: 512
batch: 8
results:
  rouge_l: 0.423
  ppl: 12.6
  answer_exact_match: 0.78
notes: int4 quick gave rouge_l 0.401; stop-token drops on ~5% long prompts
```

ci-bot: created CI run https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/888999 (artifacts pending).

zoe: sounds like the old KV-offset bug we had when remapped token ids weren't applied to KV slot ordering. boundary was around token id 5020 before.

sam: reproduce command to run locally:
```
python -m rw_infer.eval_smoke \
  --model pegasus-2x \
  --adapter customers/ceres/ceres-lora.safetensors \
  --token-map customers/ceres/token_map.json \
  --quant int4 \
  --seq 512 \
  --no-kv-cache \
  --prompts tests/ceres/long_prompts.jsonl
```

maria: running on dev GPU now. if reproduced, mitigation options: (A) re-merge adapter with --use-host-token-ids, (B) patch runtime to realign KV offsets after remap.

eli: reserving ded-pegasus-01 for a full int4 smoke (ETA ~25m). if clean, plan a canary to customer-staging with auto-fallback to hosted-pegasus-small.

sam: I'll draft a shortnotes one-pager (issue, hypothesis, mitigation, ETA). ETA: canary by EOD if ded run passes.

zoe: handoff checklist: reproduce truncation; tokenizer roundtrip (encode->decode->encode) vs token_map; int8+int4 smoke (batches 1/8/64); perf baseline for latency; canary route + monitors.

ci-bot: artifacts uploaded https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/888999/logs.tar.gz, eval_summary.json

eli: ded run done. int4 reproduces truncation on 2/30 prompts. log excerpt: "...generated text abruptly ends at token id 5021 after remap". attached snippet to CI.

maria: trying mitigation: re-merge with --use-host-token-ids then re-run smokepack.

sam: good. include migration note: forcing host ids may conflict with customers using private high-id tokens; include token_map backup and migration steps.

zoe: noted. if host-ids fix, we ship patch + run full smoke, then canary. otherwise patch runtime KV alignment.

maria: uploading minimal repro and prompt set to CI. will update thread with results. :thumbsup:
